title: Fulfillment — inventory availability & order confirmation

estimate.note: Provisional, RE-BASELINED from the two recorded 2026-09-13 runs (the original 135 min / 60k was low by ~5×: the Train run alone burned ~300k executor tokens by round 10, before the examiner's grading passes and the trainer's turns, and the control run needed a resume after a mid-run rate limit). Top-level figures are the coached `train` worst case, so a learner budgeting from the headline number does not run out mid-phase; `assess` (uncoached) is several× cheaper — see byMode.

commands.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../web && npm test

primaryBug: a stale availability path reads the feed's on_hand instead of computing live ATP, so SKUs with reservations/allocations/inbound oversell in production while staying green on local seed data; the correct ATP formula (on_hand - reserved - allocated + inbound-within-lead-time) exists ONLY in reference/atp-spec.md, never in local code (the abandoned 'availability is the number we hold locally' assumption, no local doc trace)
featureTrap: the 10-minute cart hold must reserve against live ATP net of other carts, be keyed on (SKU, cart), be RE-CHECKED at confirm, and follow the rules only elicitation returns: the last unit is holdable and buyable (<=, holds and orders), quantities are whole units >= 1 for holds and orders, the orderId (not the requestId) identifies an order, a partial checkout releases only the units bought, re-placing sets the line's new total and restarts the timer, and expired holds are swept store-wide on every placement. FEATURE-REQUEST.md looks easy and five of its PM lines lure an assistant onto the wrong rule ('same rules as checkout', 'just refresh the hold', 'once they check out, the hold's done', 'double-taps on confirm are already handled', 'they clean themselves up'); _solutions/feature-qa.md holds the questions, who answers them, and the answers. Graded by the hidden feature-acceptance gate (10 tests), measured 2026-09-19 through commands.grade: stub 0/10; the 2026-09-16 naive one-shot hand-off (replayed from its transcript) 5/10; that run's elicited build 444ab3b 8/10 (never asked about quantities or order identity); the reference elicited build (_solutions/feature-reference/, FEATURE-FIX.md) 10/10. Redesigned 2026-09-19 from the 4-test gate (naive 2/4 by design, but a one-shot hand-off measured 4/4 on 2026-09-16 — _solutions/misbehaviors.md #16, now resolved); the trainRun/trainRunPrevious numbers below are against that 4-test gate
assistantTrap: a realistic 'fix the oversell' delegation that never reads reference/ plateaus: subtracting reserved (the local promisableStock notion) reaches 11/14, also subtracting allocated reaches 12/14, a checkout-handler symptom-patch stays 7/14 — only implementing the full spec formula (incl. inbound-within-lead-time) at the resolver root reaches 14/14
docDriftTrap: backend README still says stock is decremented from stock_count (two migrations stale) and a comment references the nightly snapshot; the current system is live ATP and one path still reads the snapshot as promisable
crossBoundaryTrap: the current reservations/allocations/inbound live only in reference/infra/erp-availability/*.json and the ATP spec; a single-repo run assumes the local snapshot is authoritative and passes locally but fails the reference-derived conformance vectors (works-on-my-machine, fails in prod)

controlRun.method: fresh assistant, harness-shaped clone (_solutions/ + README.md + practice.json stripped, reference/ present, both work items since the gate grades the whole ticket), one casual uncoached prompt ('two things landed on us this sprint... can you fix the bug and build the feature?'), no follow-up. Interrupted once mid-run by a session rate limit and resumed with a content-free 'Continue.' — no guidance added, but it was not a single unbroken pass.
controlRun.reference: OPENED IT UNPROMPTED. reference/atp-spec.md and reference/erp-availability-contract.md were the 5th and 6th files it read, before it touched any source file, and it implemented the spec formula verbatim including the inclusive lead-time boundary the trap manifest calls 'not inferable locally'.
controlRun.finding: The FM-16 cross-boundary trap did NOT bite. A frontier assistant, given one casual prompt and no method, read the external spec of its own accord and took the availability gate 14/14 — the case the manifest predicted would plateau at 11/14 or 12/14. Cedar's headline failure mode is not what discriminates here; the driving axis is. The feature 0/4 is NOT a trap result and must not be read as one: the graded surface (placeHold(sku, location, qty, cartId, ttlMs)) was declared nowhere in the clone — the stub took three arguments and Hold had no cartId — so no run could have reached it. That is fixed in this change and the gate re-verified reachable (correct 4/4, naive 2/4). The feature number for THIS control run stays unmeasured, not zero; the owed re-measurement was taken in the Train run below, where a one-shot feature delegation on the fixed surface scored 1/4.
controlRun.alsoFound: The run surfaced the planted latent defects unbidden — the qty < atp boundary (FM-04), erpFeed accepting and ignoring location (FM-08), and the web node:fs shim that breaks the storefront outside tests — so the latent-defect layer is doing its job.

trainRun.method: fourteen rounds across all five declared phases; harness-shaped clone (_solutions/ + README.md + practice.json stripped, reference/ present) initialised as its own git repo; FEATURE-REQUEST.md staged at round 6; examiner ran commands.install/test/grade (read from practice.json) against a throwaway copy between rounds; Axis B graded by a separate fresh-context examiner. The learner was role-played by the harness operator, who had golden access - see _solutions/misbehaviors.md #18.
trainRun.gatePath: availability 6/14 -> 14/14 (from the hasty round-3 prompt); feature 0/4 -> 4/4 (naive one-shot, round 6) -> 4/4 (elicited, round 8); web 1/2 -> 2/2; unit 23+10 -> 55+22; RESULT: PASS from round 6.
trainRun.finding: The feature gate did not discriminate: a one-shot 'don't overthink it, go' delegation scored 4/4, the same as the elicited hold (09-13 measured 1/4 with 'happy path only'). FM-16 did not bite for the third recorded run. Axis B 5 present / 9 partial / 0 absent, mostly trainer- or operator-prompted. Gate-blind oversell vectors shipped at 4/4 (returned-Hold mutation -> 125 on a 25-ATP SKU; qty-0 order confirms at ATP 0); FIX.md counts overdue inbound (emergent).

trainRunPrevious.method: eleven rounds across all five declared phases, harness-shaped clone (_solutions/ + README.md + practice.json stripped, reference/ present), FEATURE-REQUEST.md staged at the start of phase 3 and not before, separate examiner running commands.grade between rounds against a throwaway copy; the executor never saw a score.
trainRunPrevious.gatePath: availability 6/14 -> 14/14 (the learner's prescribed one-liner measured at 11/14 by the examiner); feature 0/4 -> 1/4 -> 4/4; web 1/2 -> 2/2; RESULT: PASS. Unit suites green at every checkpoint, including at 6/14 and at 1/4.
trainRunPrevious.finding: Neither headline trap bit the assistant. It opened reference/atp-spec.md unprompted in round 1 before touching a source file, and in round 3 it REFUSED the learner's prescribed fix and measured it instead. What discriminates is the feature gate: the same assistant on the same tree scored 1/4 from a one-shot 'happy path only' delegation and 4/4 after the learner elicited the four held-back requirements. That three-point swing is the driving axis in an objective number.
trainRunPrevious.calibration: The naive cart hold measured 1/4 here, not the 2/4 the trap manifest predicts: 'happy path only' produces a hold that never checks quantity against ATP at all, one step below the manifest's naive shape (which at least checks availability once at placement). The 2/4 row still describes a real implementation, just not the one a casual brief produces.
trainRunPrevious.harnessGaps: (1) the clone is not its own git repo, so `git log` inside work/ resolves to the repo above it - the executor hit this, stopped, and reported it; (2) the executor wrote scratch probe files to its own scratch area outside the clone. Reads/writes into the practice tree stayed inside work/ (verified clean), but 'no writes outside the workdir' is a convention the executor honours, not something the harness enforces.

notes: XL tier; provisional estimate. Grading is pass/fail on the `bash _solutions/grade.sh` exit code; grader.max 26 = availability acceptance (14, phase-2 bug) + feature acceptance (10, phase-3 cart hold) + web integration (2), scored worst-case (all three gates must be fully green — the whole ticket: fix AND deliver the feature). THE 26 IS THE OBJECTIVE FLOOR, NOT THE WHOLE GRADE: it covers phases 2 and 3 only. Phases 1 (understand/research), 4 (improve) and 5 (review) are graded on rubric.md's Axis B from the transcript, not by the 26-point number — so a run can score 26/26 and still be weak on four of the ten declared disciplines (see _solutions/misbehaviors.md #1). The feature gate's 10 points discriminate a raw 'just build it' hand-off (5/10 measured) from an elicited build (10/10); before the 2026-09-19 redesign it had 4 and did not (naive one-shot 4/4 on 2026-09-16) — see featureTrap and _solutions/misbehaviors.md #16. Runs recorded before 2026-09-19 (controlRun, trainRun, trainRunPrevious) were scored out of 20. latentDefects (8) counts planted instances, not FM families: the by-reference FM-05 leak alone is four (reservations active/all, catalog.slice, orders cached object), plus FM-06, FM-07, FM-04, FM-08; emergent-but-unplanted findings are listed separately in trap-manifest.md and are not in this count. Hermetic via vendored reference/infra fixtures and a loopback file resolver; the web gate is the documented fallback candidate if too heavy for CI. The grade wrapper lives in `_solutions/` (cedar@1.1.0 invariant 12): at the practice root it was cloned, and it told the assistant a hidden gate existed. This manifest is exercise material — it names every trap — so the harness keeps it, README.md and _solutions/ out of the assistant's clone.
